create.name: Ani Anderson
create.bio:
Ani Anderson began her working life as an occupational therapist and moved steadily into holistic practice, qualifying along the way in massage, energy medicine, craniosacral work, qigong and tai chi, and leading a meditation sangha in the tradition of Thich Nhat Hanh. With her partner Brian Trzaskos she built two wellness centres and a training institute for rehabilitation therapists, and the two now run the Somatic Coaching Academy, where she is chief executive and heads the coaching and business programmes. She is a certified professional coach and also reads Human Design charts.

Her own method, set out in her book Find Your Soul's Agenda, asks people to trace the emotional patterns that keep recurring in their lives and distil their purpose into a single word, which then serves as a guide for choices and relationships. With Brian she wrote Manifestation For Dummies, which approaches manifestation through what they call the natural laws and through close attention to sensation in the body, and together they created Sensation-Based Motivation Coaching. She works mostly online with business owners and leaders, in one-day private deep dives and a year-long group mastermind, and occasionally in person at Kripalu. She lives in a log cabin near Lake Champlain in upstate New York.

books.title: Manifestation For Dummies
books.author: Ani Anderson, Brian Trzaskos
books.description: A plain-language guide, written with Brian Trzaskos, that sets out a step-by-step route to manifesting. It explains the natural laws the authors see at work in creation and pairs them with body-based practices for setting intentions and noticing old patterns.

books.title: Find Your Soul's Agenda: The One Word That Will Make Your Whole Life a Success
books.author: Ani Anderson
books.description: Her guide to discovering life purpose. Readers work through their recurring emotional highs and lows to find the one word that names their soul's agenda, and learn to spot the habits of resistance that pull them off course.

courses.title: Embodied Manifestation: The Roadmap to Creating the Life You Desire
courses.description: A residential Kripalu programme, co-led with Brian Trzaskos, drawn from their book Manifestation For Dummies. Participants map their own manifestation route, look at the unconscious patterns behind recurring problems, set intentions and practise somatic exercises for working with life-force energy.

courses.title: Living the Laws Mastermind
courses.description: A twelve-month small-group programme for founders and leaders, run with Brian Trzaskos. Each month takes one natural law through the book's roadmap, with two hours of group learning, an integration call and a practical monthly challenge.

courses.title: Find Your Purpose Deep Dive and Private Coaching
courses.description: A one-day private session built on her Find Your Soul's Agenda process, which can lead into three-, six- or nine-month coaching programmes. Clients start with an interest form and a call to be matched with a coach.
